definitionZh: *icker-icon CSS伪元素瞄准与它们相关联的拾取者图标内置形式控件. 如果是自定义的选择元素,它会选择关闭时在元素上显示的向下点的箭头图标.
sourceDefinition: The ::picker-icon CSS pseudo-element targets the picker icon inside form controls that have an icon associated with them. In the case of a customizable select element, it selects the arrow icon shown on the element that points down when it is closed.
